Phase 3 Clinical Trial in Locally Advanced or Metastatic First-Line TNBC A Phase 3 clinical trial (NCT06419621) is being conducted in China to evaluate pumitamig in combination with chemotherapy compared to chemotherapy alone as a first-line treatment for patients with locally advanced or metastatic TNBC. – In July 2026, the trial completed enrollment. – Based on current event accrual projections, the first interim data is expected in 2027.

AHEAD-MERIT Phase 2/3 Clinical Trial in Unresectable Recurrent or Metastatic, PD-L1+, HPV16+ HNSCC A Phase 2/3 clinical trial (NCT04534205) is being conducted to evaluate BNT113 in combination with pembrolizumab versus pembrolizumab monotherapy as a first-line treatment for patients with unresectable recurrent or metastatic, PD-L1+, HPV16+ HNSCC. – In October 2026, the first topline results from this trial were announced.
